steps.description: Given the overlays and thermi in each of their states (how many overlays and which are hidden, locked or on the desktop; a broken file, a stopped service, saved looks, an update ready), and the pill the menu opens on, when thermi's menu and the overlay's menu are built, then each holds its entries in their groups and order, with their checks and bold default: a locked overlay offers no Separate, at four overlays Separate is grayed with why, and no entry offered does nothing.

Given the overlay, when the author opens the window from each way in (the overlay's menu, thermi's menu, a double-click on a value or the edge, `thermi settings`, Start), with the window closed and then behind others, then one window opens on the right item or overlay, or comes to the front focused.

Given a real overlay host and window beacon on a test desktop, when each message between them is sent (the history, a value selected or double-clicked, an edit, a gesture, a second thermi), then the other side acts on it within 500 ms.

Given --trace and the overlay's CPU time and memory, when the window opens cold and warm, stays idle, has a knob dragged for a minute, closes, and an hour of use passes, then the first frame is under 2 s cold and 1 s warm, every paint lands within 300 ms of its input at most 10 times a second, the budgets hold, no window or WebView2 process is left, and memory stays within 5 MB.

Given the page and a fake bridge in each kind of trouble (the driver missing, no overlay, the service stopped or stale, a broken file), when the page shows it and its action is taken, then the page offers the fix, takes no edit while the file is broken, and moves on as the fake answers.

Given a real PC, when the author opens the window without the overlay, stops and starts the service, installs the driver refusing and then accepting Windows' prompt, and edits, breaks and restores the file by hand, then the window follows each and recovers on its own.
Given edits of each kind, and several changes of one box within a second, when they are undone and redone, then each step is named after what it changed, and the changes within a second are one step.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when an edit is undone and redone by keys, also with a slider focused, and by the title row's buttons, then the settings go back and forth, the buttons stay reachable when unavailable, the pane shows what changed, and the toast that says so moves nothing and goes after 6 s.

Given an item added, one deleted and one moved by the window, and the added one then edited by hand, when all three are undone, then the deleted item is back in place, the move is reverted, and the hand-edited item stays, its step skipped.

Given the page with two overlays, when the list is used by keys alone (moving, folding, type-ahead, renaming, moving and deleting items, sending a pill to another overlay from its menu, the shortcuts), an item is dragged out to its own pill, a pill before another and an item onto another overlay's pill, then the selection, the pane and the settings follow, Delete selects the next row, the arrows never leave the list, and the rows keep their names while values refresh.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when the catalog opens from each overlay, is searched, adds with Enter and with Ctrl+Enter, and Esc is pressed twice, then the item lands on the overlay picked, the catalog closes or stays as asked, and the new item is selected and in view.

Given the admin recording, when the catalog is searched by words in any order, by name, device, type, synonym and chip, and by a word that matches nothing, then each search lists exactly its sensors, and the last offers one word instead.
Given readings over two minutes on a fake clock, when a sparkline is read, then it holds the last minute and nothing older.

Given the recording without admin rights, when the catalog is built, then the CPU temperature, power and clocks reading zero say the driver may be missing, and the clocks with no value say they read nothing.

Given every sensor of the admin recording, when each is added as an item, then each shows in its type's unit, joins the pill of its device's kind or goes at the end, and is named like the defaults, by its sensor's name when that name is taken and with a number when the same sensor is added again.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when each row of the item page is changed by keys (Sensor, Shows, Smoothing, Label, Graph, Notify me, Separate pill, Tray icon and More options), then the settings hold the change; a row that cannot apply is locked with its reason; the page keeps its scroll and the control looked at stays in place through picks, switches, undos and new readings; and Warn by offers only the item's own readings.

Given series derived from the recorded one, with the board's fan answering the load more strongly or at once, when the finder replays them, then it starts the load only after 3 s of readings, runs at least 8 s, and stops 3 s after a fan meets the rule or at 8 s if that is later.

Given the CPU fan item and a fake finder, when "Find it" is asked and turned down, then run, cancelled, run again and its pick used, then nothing loads until "Load the CPU", the row shows the run and its result in place, Cancel stops it, and using the pick changes the item's sensor.

Given Task Manager and a board that drives the CPU fan, when the finder runs and is cancelled, then every core is loaded at idle priority, the load ends within a second of Cancel, and a full run picks the CPU fan.

Given recorded and derived series where a fan answers the load, where none does, where two fans answer alike, and where the finder cannot judge (a load under 80 %, no driver, no fan outside the GPUs), when the finder replays each, then it picks the answering fan, keeping what the item warns by as one undo step, or picks nothing and says why.

Given readings of each type (power, clock, memory, temperatures of CPUs, GPUs and boards, a load, a duty, a fan's speed), when each is what an item warns by, then its accepted lines, default lines, unit, step, chart range and color bands are its type's; an item may warn only by its own readings, a fan also by its duty; the lowest line held for over half of the ten minutes fires; and each second of the chart says its reading and how long ago it came, or none in a gap.

Given an item's page, when a knob is dragged, clicked, typed into, moved by every key, pushed past the other and deleted, and then the readings stop, then the lines follow, the box keeps or reverts its value, the focus lands on the next control, and the chart says why it stopped while its lines and knobs stay.

Given the page with two monitors, when each of Placement's controls is chosen by keys (the map's spots and the taskbar's, a monitor that is gone, vertical, When to show, lock, click-through, OLED care), then the settings hold the change.

Given monitors at 100 % and 150 %, when the overlay snaps to each corner, then it sits inside the work area, the top corners 64 px below its top times the scale; and an overlay larger than the work area keeps its top-left corner inside it.

Given an overlay beside the notification area, one dropped on the taskbar and one in a corner, when its width grows, then the edge each keeps stays put, and on a taller taskbar it stays in its middle.
Given a snapped overlay, when it is moved further than the drag distance and dropped, then the snap is gone and the dropped position is saved.
Given the overlay snapped to the second monitor, when the PC restarts, and when that monitor moves to another port, then the snap still finds it.

Given the page with two overlays, when each of Appearance's controls is changed by keys (the look tiles, size, theme, layout, graph, opacity, text, shape, colors, saving, renaming and exporting a look), then the settings hold the change; Default takes the whole look back with its tile checked, no tile is checked once the look changed, a saved look is the one checked, and the page does not move.
Given every edit that would leave the settings invalid, when it is applied, then the settings are unchanged and the reason is returned.
Given two writers that read the file at the same moment, when both write, then the file holds both changes.
Given a file emptied and then written again, and one removed and then put back, as editors save, when each is read meanwhile, then the overlay never shows the defaults and the file is not recreated.
Given a broken file, when the settings are restored, then the broken file is kept under a dated name and the last good settings are written.
Given the window's own write, when its watcher event arrives, then it is not taken as an outside change.

Given a version 1 file with sources, when it is read, then it becomes the current version with each source applied to its items and what they warn by, and shows the same overlay: an item without a meter draws nothing, a source of the wrong type still shows as missing, lines left at version 1's defaults take the current calm ones, and lines the user moved are kept.
Given a file with items without ids and one with a repeated id, when it is read twice, then both reads give the same unique ids, the first holder keeps a repeated id, and a write stores them.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when the design prototype's sequences of keys and clicks run, then after each step the focus is on a control in view, never the page, dialogs keep it inside, and menus give it back; the steps on Windows' own frame are A220's.

Given every page, dialog, menu, bar and toast, in light, dark and forced colors, and with reduced motion, when axe checks each and the animations are read, then axe finds no violation and nothing animates.

Given Narrator, light, dark, another accent, high contrast and animation effects off, when the author moves through the window, resizes, maximizes, snaps and activates it over the overlays, and maximizes and restores it from its caption button and from the system menu, then everything is read with its name, role and value, looks right, nothing animates, the focus stays where it was, also once Esc closes the system menu, and the edited overlay stays above the window unless it would cover the caption buttons.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when the language, the unit, the window's theme and Start with Windows change, a hotkey is recorded, refused, cleared and cancelled, and Reset is asked and cancelled, then the settings hold each change, Start with Windows is outside undo, thermi's hotkeys rest while one records, and Cancel is the destructive dialog's default.
Given Start with Windows turned off, when thermi is reinstalled and the author signs out and in, then the overlay does not start, and Ctrl+Z never touched the switch.

Given two overlays with every field changed, when the settings are reset, and the reset is undone after a hand edit, then one default overlay is left, always shown, the language, hotkeys, unit and window theme stay, and undo brings back every field still at its default while the hand edit stays.

Given the default settings, when the look is read and then one size changes, then it is standard text on pills that match the taskbar, green meters at normal and darker level colors on light pills, each 3:1 against its pill and a graph's unlit track, and the change makes the look the overlay's own, keeping the rest; a look's tile samples it as three lit pills.

Given light and dark wallpapers and taskbars, when the author looks at the overlay in each theme, font, effect and a 0 % background, at each level, at the first critical, with a stopped service and over its tooltips, then every value reads well, the levels read without color, the glow comes once, and the tooltips say what to do.

Given Auto text on dark and light pills, a custom gray label, and a white value on light pills, when the overlay is laid out, then Auto gives each theme's text colors, the gray is kept, and the white is drawn in its Auto color and flagged as unreadable.

Given settings with items, placement, layout, direction, language and a look, when the look is read from them, then it holds the theme, the background opacity, the colors, the text and the shape, and no layout, direction, position or size.

Given a look file and the same look as pasted text, when each is imported and then undone, then the overlay shows it at once and undo brings back the look before; saved with "Save as my look", it is listed, and under a taken name it asks for another.

Given style files that are broken, of a newer format, or with a field out of range or of the wrong kind, when they are imported, then each is refused with a reason naming the field, and nothing changes.

Given a full-screen video and a borderless game, the four hotkeys and thermi's icon, when the author hides and shows the overlays each way, presses each hotkey, and opens both menus by mouse and keyboard, then the overlays follow, a hotkey another app holds is refused, and the menus are Windows' own and follow the theme.

Given four hotkeys written within a second and an overlay that has registered only the first, when the window asks for the hotkey status, then it trusts no answer until its hash matches the four it shows; and with no overlay running, it says the hotkeys need it.

Given one overlay hidden on its own, when "Hide overlays" is set, the file is read again, thermi's icon is clicked, the window opens on the hidden overlay and thermi starts again, then the flag is never in the file, the click clears only the flag, the hidden overlay stays off the desktop whatever the window edits, and a new start shows the overlays by their own visibility.
Given Windows in Spanish, and then `thermi settings --pseudo`, when the author goes through both menus, every page and the catalog, then every text thermi writes is Spanish, and long texts fit.
Given English as the language on a Windows set to Spanish regional format, when values are formatted, then they follow the Spanish number format.
Given the English texts and every translation, when their keys are compared, then each translation has every key and no others.

Given window sizes from the smallest up, text at 100 % and 200 %, and English and the long pseudo-language, when every page, dialog and menu shows in each, then nothing is cut, overlaps or scrolls sideways, and the list folds where it should.

Given the overlay in each state (each level, a missing driver or a sensor reading nothing, the service stopped or stale, overlays hidden or click-through, high contrast, before and after the window first opens), when the overlay, its tooltips, thermi's tooltip and thermi's mark are decided, then each shows its parts, the mark its state, one pill stands in while the sensors are stopped, and thermi's tooltip stays within 127 characters.

Given an overlay with a clock among the sensors' items and the service stopped, when the overlay and the tray icons are decided, then the "Sensors stopped" pill stands in for the sensors' items only, the clock shows its time beside it and in its tray icon, and thermi's mark still says the sensors stopped.

Given thermi's icon and three item icons at 100 %, 150 % and 200 % on a dark and a light taskbar, when the PC restarts, Explorer restarts and the items change level, then the icons read at a glance, keep their pins, come back, and the mark wakes and alarms.
Given temperatures, percentages, fan speeds, memory sizes and a missing value, when each becomes a tray icon's text, then it fits in four characters, rounded or scaled with k, in the regional format.
Given values that do not change, when the icons refresh for ten seconds, then none is redrawn; when one value changes, only its icon is.
Given 62 °C with lines at 70 and 85, when the unit is °F, then it reads 144 °F, the lines show 158 and 185, the file keeps 70 and 85, and a line set to 150 °F is kept as 65.6.

Given units hidden, when the default items, thermi's tooltip and an item icon's tooltip are made, then values show without units and labels stay, thermi's tooltip follows the overlay, and the item icon's tooltip keeps its unit; given labels hidden, the pills keep their items and show no label.

Given each event that brings a notice (a first start, the window opened, overlays hidden, click-through turned on, clicks coming back), when the notices are decided, then each shows once in its form with its buttons, none comes from the window, and each goes when what it is about ends.

Given a first start, overlays hidden from thermi's menu, click-through turned on, and an item critical with Notify me, when each notice shows, then it comes from thermi's icon with its buttons, its actions work, and clicks pass through the overlay until click-through is off.

Given 100 warm-up rounds, each painting the overlay, refreshing three tray icons, reloading the settings and seeing the window's mutex appear and vanish, when 10,000 more run, then GDI and USER handles are exactly where they were after the warm-up, and the managed heap after a full collection is within 1 MB.

Given the CPU's CCD temperatures and core powers from the admin recording, when items combine the temperatures as highest and average with an offset, and the powers as a sum, then they read the highest, the average with its offset, and the total power; a sum of temperatures and an offset past its type's range are refused, an offset converts with the unit, and with every sensor missing the item shows as missing.
Given an item showing its maximum, and values 60, 75 and 70 on a fake clock, when they arrive and then min and max are reset, then it shows 75, and then the next value.

Given values at each level on dark and light pills and under high contrast, percentages outside 0 to 100, and bars and lines, when the overlay is laid out, then each value carries its level's mark, percentages are held between 0 and 100, and an item that thresholds judge draws its line or its lit bars, while power draws neither.

Given the GPU item set to show only on alert, when it reads under and then over its warning on an overlay snapped right, then the GPU pill is gone with the right edge kept, and then back at its warning level; with the window open it always shows; an item that thresholds cannot judge cannot be set to alert-only, and one that warns by nothing loses alert-only and its graph.
Given two overlays in the file, when it is read, then each has its own items, placement and style, ids are unique across both, and a version 1 file becomes one overlay.

Given each edit of overlays (made, duplicated, merged, deleted or hidden in the window; an item or pill moved to another or a new overlay by a hold and a drag; a drop on another overlay, on the taskbar or in a corner; Alt+arrows), when each is applied and undone, then the overlays follow, at most four, unnamed and called by where they sit, an emptied one removed, a hold refused at four overlays, and each edit one undo step.

Given the page with three overlays, when one is made, duplicated, merged, hidden, shown and deleted from the list and from the overlay page, then the settings follow, the new one takes the focus, and after a delete or a merge the focus is on the next row or the target.

Given four overlays on two monitors and a crowded taskbar, when the author clicks values with the window open, holds pills until they lift and drags them off, onto another overlay and onto the desktop, drags before the hold, presses Esc during a drag, merges and resizes overlays, opens and closes apps, and undoes a gesture from the overlay's menu, then the window follows, the marks and fades show, a lifted pill joins where it is let go or becomes an overlay that snaps, a drag before the hold moves the whole overlay, Esc puts everything back, a hidden overlay shows only in the window, and no overlay on the taskbar moves as apps open and close.

Given an item with Notify me on a fake clock, and critical episodes that are too short, long enough, held, ended and back, or during a full-screen app, when the notices are decided, then one comes per episode after 10 s, and one held through full screen comes on leaving it, with its peak and length.

Given work areas, monitor setups and free overlays of each kind, when the window's first size and place, its minimum, its remembered size, the list's width and fold, and the pane's columns are decided, then each fits its room.

Given hotkey combinations that Windows owns, that apps commonly use, that the window or another hotkey already takes, or that type a character, and free ones, when each is judged, then each taken one is refused with its reason and each free one is taken.

Given two overlays dropped on the taskbar, the second where the first ends, when they are placed, then each sits at its own offset on the same line, touching, with no room kept between them or beside any app button.
Given a 0 % background, when the overlay is laid out, then every pixel of every pill has an alpha of at least 1, and with click-through off the overlay catches a click between two values.

Given throughputs from bytes to gigabytes a second, in English and Spanish regional formats, with units shown and hidden, and as a tray icon's text, when each is formatted, then it reads in its unit with three significant digits, keeps its scale letter without units, and fits the tray icon's four characters.

Given an admin recording with two adapters and two drives, when the catalog is built and the network and disk metrics are picked, then adapters sit under Network and drives under Disk, each metric follows its adapter or drive, a drive's temperature is a temperature, and an item that names an adapter keeps it.

Given a throughput and a disk activity as what an item warns by, when each is chosen, then neither starts with lines, and the throughput's chart runs from 0 to its highest reading plus 15 %, rounded up to a 1-2-5 step.

Given the recording's download, upload, read and write rates, when each is added as an item, then download and upload share one NET pill, each value with its direction arrow, read and write take their own labels, and the default overlay is unchanged.

Given the page with the fake bridge holding two adapters and two drives, when the catalog opens, then it offers a Network group and a Disk group by role, and the Throughput chip filters to their rates.

Given a PC with two drives and two adapters and the service running as installed, when the author downloads a large file and copies one between drives, then the NET pill and the disk items follow the busy adapter and drive, the catalog lists both groups, and the service stays under 80 MB of private memory at rest.

Given a battery's charge, its rate while charging and discharging, its time remaining, and no time while plugged in, in English and Spanish regional formats, when each is formatted, then the charge is a percentage, the rate is in watts with its sign, the time reads in hours and minutes, and no time shows as missing.

Given a laptop's recording with a battery and virtual adapters, and the desktop recordings, when the catalog is built and the metrics are picked, then the battery sits under Battery on the laptop and no Battery group exists on the desktops, and Auto's adapter is never a loopback, tunnel or virtual one while a physical one moves data.

Given snapshots on the injected clock with a gap longer than the stale limit, as across a sleep, when the overlay is decided before and after the first fresh snapshot, then no value from before the gap shows as live, the history leaves the gap out of Min, Avg, Max and the chart, and the first fresh snapshot brings the values back.

Given a snapped overlay and a wake from sleep with a different set of monitors, when the layout changes, then the overlay goes back to its snap, or to the same spot on the primary monitor when its own is gone.
Given the page with a fake bridge for a laptop and one for a desktop, when the catalog opens, then the laptop's offers a Battery group by role and the desktop's offers none.

Given a laptop with the service running as installed and an external monitor, when the author adds the battery's items, unplugs the laptop, puts it to sleep, unplugs the monitor and wakes it, then the battery reads its charge, rate and time, no stale value shows as live after waking, readings come back within 5 s without a click, and the overlays go back to their places.

Given a PC with WSL or Hyper-V and a VPN on, when the author downloads a large file, then Auto follows the physical adapter; and with Task Manager beside the overlay, at rest and during `thermi cpu-load 30`, CPU load stays within 3 points of Task Manager's CPU utilization on Windows 11.

Given a Windows 10 22H2 64-bit virtual machine with thermi installed, when the author opens the window in light, dark and high contrast and uses the overlay on the taskbar and the desktop, then the window is readable on an opaque background with square corners, nothing is missing or transparent, and the overlay sits on the taskbar, drags, hides and shows as on Windows 11.

Given the recorded desktop, whose board chip names its inputs by number, and a made-up board with another chip, when the catalog is built, then the known chip's inputs show their probable names, each marked likely beside the library's name, the other inputs keep the library's name with the chip and the input, no other sensor gets either, and the search finds a sensor by its probable name.

Given the recorded desktop with and without administrator rights, when the catalog is built before and after a stopped fan turns, then it hides what nobody would add (sensors reading nothing, board fans that never turned, per-engine GPU loads, effective clocks) and counts what each search hides, keeps the CPU sensors that need the driver and a resting GPU fan, shows a fan once it has turned, and never lists a drive's fixed limits or wear counters.

Given the recorded desktop and an overlay with two items of one board sensor, one renamed by hand, when the sensor is renamed in the catalog, too long, empty, undone and redone, a new item of it is added and the overlay is reset, then the name is kept by sensor id, the item thermi named takes it while the other keeps its own, the catalog and its search use it, a name over 40 characters is refused, an empty one gives back the library's, each rename is one step, a new item is named by it, and a reset keeps it.

Given the page with the fake bridge over the recorded desktop, when a search lists only what the catalog hides and "Show all" is pressed, and a board input is renamed with F2, left once with Esc and once kept with Enter, then added, then Show all lists the hidden sensors, Esc changes nothing and gives the row back the focus, the name typed reaches the settings, and the new item is named by it.

Given an overlay on the taskbar at an offset, and one without, when the notification area grows, the taskbar moves to the top, the screen narrows or changes scale, the taskbar hides or stands on a side, or its notification area is not found, then the first keeps its offset, whole on the taskbar, or floats just above the work area's bottom where it cannot sit on the taskbar; the second follows the notification area, or keeps its distance from the end.

Given the page with a fake bridge whose main taskbar is on a side, and then hides, when the overlay snapped to its taskbar is selected, then the Position row says why it floats; and "Fade near the pointer", switched by keys, lands in the settings.

Given Windows 10 with the taskbar at each edge and hiding, and Windows 11 with third-party taskbars at the top and clear, when the author drops the overlay along each taskbar, then it sits on each taskbar that lies across its monitor where it was dropped and floats clear of the others, the window saying why; moving or hiding the taskbar, restarting Explorer, or changing the resolution or scale moves the overlay with it within a second at the same offset; and an overlay dropped half off the screen shows whole inside the work area.

Given the recorded desktop without administrator rights, with Windows' uptime, address and clock, when the catalog is built and the three are added as items, then the catalog lists them under PC, and the overlay shows UP, IP and TIME with the uptime, the address and the time with its seconds in the regional format, none with a level; and with no address, the local IP shows as missing.

Given times, addresses and throughputs in bits, when each is formatted, then a time shows its seconds in the regional format, an address its four numbers, and a throughput in bits takes bps, Kbps, Mbps or Gbps with three significant digits, keeping its letter without units and in a tray icon.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when a network speed's item opens More options and its bits switch is pressed by keys, then the switch lands in the settings, and an item of another type offers none.
Given thermi's menu and an overlay's menu, when they are built, then "Open Task Manager" follows "Settings…" in thermi's, and "Copy as image" is in the overlay's.

Given thermi installed, when the author opens Task Manager from both menus, points at the CPU and GPU values, runs `thermi cpu-load 30` with the CPU's lines lowered until it is critical, copies the overlay as an image into Paint, turns on Fade near the pointer and moves the pointer toward the overlay and away, and removes the driver, then Task Manager opens, the tooltips name the models, the busiest process and any throttling, the picture is the overlay, the overlay fades and comes back while still taking a double-click, and the CPU pill says Driver, whose double-click opens the window with the driver's bar; and the overlay stays within R154's budget with Fade on.

Given the recorded desktop with and without administrator rights, a busiest process and items of several devices, when the overlay's scene and its tooltips are made, then a CPU's or GPU's value names its model, a critical one also its busiest process, a value of another device neither, and without the driver the CPU's temperature and power show Driver with the driver's tooltip, while the GPU's load still shows its value.

Given the recorded desktop with its CPU clock and temperature set to each case, with a base clock or none, when the overlay's scene is made, then the CPU's temperature and clock are marked throttling, with a tooltip saying so, only while the clock is under the base clock and the temperature at warning or above.

Given the overlay running on the recorded desktop, with the clipboard faked, when "Copy as image" is chosen from its menu, then the clipboard holds one PNG the size of the overlay as it shows, and the real clipboard is never touched.

Given overlays, pointers at each distance and the states that turn fading off, when the overlay's opacity is decided, then it is whole beyond 96 px at its scale, 25 % with the pointer on it and in between as the pointer nears, and whole while fading is off, the window is open, it is dragged or click-through is on.
Given free overlays dropped on the desktop, half off the screen, over the taskbar or across two monitors, when each is placed, then it shows whole inside the work area of the monitor it lies most on.

Given the monitors as Windows listed them before the taskbar moved to another edge or began to hide, when the overlay reads them for a paint, then each comes with the work area Windows gives at that moment.

Given the installed build and its window open on its first item for 30 s, when `scripts/measure.ps1 -Window` measures it for 60 s, then the window and its renderer use under 1 % of one core together, and minimized, the renderer nothing.
Given the window hidden, when a second's readings come, then it draws none of them, and once it shows again it draws the latest.
Given the default overlay painted, when the open window marks CPU load as selected, then its mark is a bar under the value's middle, wider than tall.

Given a taskbar with its notification area and an overlay 550 px wide, when it is dropped along the taskbar, near its marks or a corner's, past the monitor's edge toward a corner, or with Alt held, then on the taskbar it stays where it was let go, centered across it and whole on it, unless a mark is within 96 px, which it goes to; near a corner it goes to the corner's mark; and with Alt held it stays where it was let go.

Given the recorded desktop and items reading sensors of each kind of device, one the dropdown leaves out but the item names, and one whose sensor is not read, when each item's Sensor dropdown is built, then it lists its own device's sensors of its type first and the other devices' only behind "Show all", and an item whose sensor is not read lists every device's at once.

Given the recorded desktop, with a CPU's graphics chip and a graphics card, when the chip's frequency, the card's fan duty and the chip's load are added in turn, then the card's fan duty joins the GPU pill and the chip's two sensors join an iGPU pill at the end.
Given the window open on an overlay and a value, when it is minimized and restored, then it tells the overlay it edits none, so no value is marked nor overlay faded, and then marks them again.

Given the recorded desktop's catalog, when searches of each kind are typed (words in either order, accents and capitals, the metric a sensor feeds, a long word with a typo, a short one), then the best rows come first, each with what matched marked, and a short word with a typo finds nothing.

Given the window in dark and in light, when the author types in the catalog's search and in a Sensor dropdown's filter, then each row marks what matched on a faint accent, readable in both themes and under high contrast; the dropdown's status line says the count, a row says when nothing matches, and Enter takes the first.

Given a version 2 file with an item without a meter, a load metered by itself without lines, and a load with a warning line, when it is read, then it becomes version 6, each item drawing as it did, and the default overlay's CPU and GPU loads draw their lines.

Given two overlays, when one is dragged over the other, then it shows whole, the other ringed with a bar where it would join, and no snap mark lights; a pill held still lifts, leaving an empty slot; after a drop no tooltip shows until the pointer leaves or 1.5 s pass; the Position map's taskbar spot sits under the overlay's middle; Esc mid-drag reaches no other app; and on a load's item page, Graph follows Label, and None keeps the load drawing nothing after a restart.

Given an overlay dragged near a corner's mark, with its marks showing, when it is let go, let go with Alt held, cancelled with Esc, or loses the mouse to another window, then it snaps to the corner, stays free where it was let go, or goes back to its snap with the file unchanged, and nothing of the drag is left on screen; Esc counts also with the mouse still.
Given the overlay process, when Exit thermi is chosen, or Windows asks its host window or an overlay to close, then its window goes and its message loop ends.

Given version 4 files with an overlay at the taskbar's right, left and center, and one in a corner, when each is read, then the taskbar ones take its one place, beside the notification area for the right and the center and 8 px from the start for the left, and the corner stays.

Given a lifted pill and an overlay of one pill moved whole, when either is dropped on another overlay, before or past a pill, or back on its own overlay or place, then it joins that overlay before or after the pill it was dropped at, moves to the front of its own, or stays where it was.

Given the overlay on a desktop of its own, when a pill is held still until it lifts and dropped, a press leaves and comes back before the hold, and overlays and lifted pills are dragged onto others, with and without Alt, or thrown onto the desktop, then a pill lifts only when held still, an overlay moves whole, a drop joins the overlay before the pill it is let go on, with Alt held it stays apart, and one thrown far becomes an overlay of its own.

Given overlays side by side on a taskbar, one of them hidden, when an overlay or a lifted pill is dragged with the cursor on another, just above it, half or less over it, over two at once, or with Alt held, then it targets the overlay under the cursor or the one it covers most, joining at the cursor, none while less than half covers either or with Alt held, and never the hidden one.

Given two overlays, one on the taskbar and one in a corner, with the window open, when the window works out where each shows, then it is where each overlay's own window is, so the map's taskbar spot sits at the overlay's middle.
Given the built page in a real WebView2, when the window opens, then the keyboard focus is in the page, so Ctrl+Z works without a click first.
Given a free overlay, when it is dropped on the taskbar near the mark beside the notification area, then it keeps no offset, so it follows the notification area as it grows.

Given the recorded CPU load series replayed as `thermi preview` replays it, on dark and light pills, when the overlay is painted at 100 % and 150 %, then the CPU load's graph is 24 px wide at 100 % and draws each second as a line in the normal level's green over a light fill, never a block.

Given the admin recording's CPU temperature warned by itself, when the overlay is painted at 100 % on dark pills and at 150 % past a warning line on light ones, then its bars are five segments 12 px wide at 100 %, the lit ones in its level's color and the rest a faint track, and the value at warning has no underline.
Given the RAM's load at several values and reading nothing, when the overlay is laid out, then its meter lights the segments its value rounds to, and none while it reads nothing.

Given each overlay Graph (Auto, None, Bars, Line), each item's own choice, and readings of each kind past their warning, when the overlay is laid out, then each item draws its own choice or else the overlay's, Auto drawing a line for a load and bars for the rest, power nothing whatever is chosen, and only an item that draws nothing underlines its warning.

Given a version 5 file with every field and items metered in each way, when it is read, then it is the version 6 file with the same fields, the ones version 6 added at their defaults, each item drawing and warning as it did.

Given Windows' apps light or dark and high contrast on or off, when the window's theme is Windows, Light or Dark, then the window is light or dark as chosen, as Windows' apps are for Windows, and as Windows' apps are under high contrast whatever was chosen; the file leaves Windows out.

Given the real window over Windows' dark mode, when Theme is set to Light, Dark and Windows, and the window is opened again in Light, then each applies at once to the page, the title row, the caption buttons and Mica, and the first frame of the window opened in Light is already light.

Given a series of CPU temperatures with a missing one and an overlay in one bar whose items show averages, smoothed and offset values and a maximum reset midway, when the window takes the overlay's history through the message and both read the rest, then each second the window lays out each item with the very value, label and tag the overlay does.

Given the recorded CPU load series and an overlay in one bar showing an average, when the overlay reads part of the series before the real bridge opens and hands over its history, and both read the rest, then each second the bridge's item shows the very value, label and tag the overlay draws.

Given the page with the fake bridge and the default overlay in one bar, when the RAM's Shows is set to Average by keys, then its row in the list says the bridge's value with its tag, and its Label box offers the label the bridge says the overlay draws.

Given the default overlay on the taskbar, free, at the monitor's left edge, vertical, and vertical near the work area's bottom, when "Separate" is chosen on its GPU pill, then the pill becomes an overlay of its own, as wide as a drag of it carries, 8 px before the overlay, level with its middle, or after, below or above it where there is no room.

Given a menu's entries sharing first letters, in any case and language, with an "&" in their text, with no letter left, or grayed, when their access keys are marked, then each entry gets a key no entry above it took, from a word's start first, or none, a grayed note none, and an "&" of the text stays one.

Given a real overlay host on a test desktop with the default overlay, when its GPU pill is right-clicked and the access key of "Separate" is typed, then the file holds the pill as an overlay of its own, and the menu's Undo puts it back in one step.

Given the installed build, the window open, and the overlay on the taskbar and on the desktop, in English and Spanish, light, dark and high contrast, when the author right-clicks a pill, the edge and an item's tray icon, and chooses each entry by mouse and by its key, then each changes what it says at once, the window shows it, the menu's Undo and Ctrl+Z in the window take it back, and no entry offered does nothing.

Given the overlay page, when the theme is set to Light and then undone, then the preview at the top of Appearance shows the picture C# paints of the change, and then the one before; and it shows one picture pixel per device pixel, as wide as the overlay in a wide window and as the column in a narrow one.

Given a recorded snapshot and an overlay in a light look with soft corners, a 60 % background and bars, when the window previews it, then its picture is pixel for pixel the one "Copy as image" puts on the clipboard.

Given the installed build at 100 % and 150 %, when the overlay page is open on the taskbar overlay, then the preview and the look tiles look as the overlay does on screen, each edit shows within a second, and the idle window stays within R191's budget.

Given the CPU fan's page with its fan at about 1,100 RPM and no lines, when a warning line is added, moved by the arrows, dragged up while held, and a press beside the knobs drags across the chart, then the line comes above the fan's speed and under one and a half times it, moves a step each way, its knob stays under the pointer while the range holds, and no text is selected.

Given files whose items are laid out in one bar, in pills and each layout, with pills started, dragged off and merged, when the window lists the first overlay, then its pills are the runs the overlay labels, and a join or split keeps apart the pills that showed apart.

Given the default overlay in one bar with the admin recording's readings, at 100 % on dark pills, at 150 % on light ones and vertical, when it is painted, then the bar holds the CPU, GPU and RAM pills in the inner color, 4 px inside its edge and 4 px apart at 100 %, side by side or stacked as wide as the widest, and each item's pill is its run's.

Given the overlay's ten minutes of the RAM in use metered by its load, and the window's seconds of it and of the CPU temperature showing its minimum, when Warn by turns off and the CPU temperature reads another sensor, and both are undone, then each chart draws only the reading it currently draws, with what the window read of it before, and the minimum is of that reading alone.

Given an overlay at sizes up to 400 % and text up to 36 px on taskbars of each height and scale, and free or vertical, when the size it shows at is worked out, then on a taskbar it is at most the taskbar's height, its pills grown for the text included, and elsewhere its own.
Given a host that painted the recording on its tick, when a warmer snapshot comes before the next tick, then the overlay already shows it, as the open window does.

Given a sensor pipe on the real clock and a client reading it, when the fan finder's load spins every core for 8 s, then the load runs at idle priority and keeps the cores busy, and a snapshot still comes each second, never 2 s apart.

Given the CPU temperature item on Auto with a chart of the window's readings, when its Sensor is set to another for a few seconds and undone, then its chart holds only the seconds of the sensor Auto picks.

Given two overlays side by side on a taskbar, when one grows into the other, then it pushes the other a margin away, toward the notification area only, while the one beside the notification area stays; two that do not overlap stay at their snaps; one grown past the room left shows at that room, never smaller than at 100 %, so neither leaves the taskbar, covers the other or goes over the app buttons; and on a nearly full taskbar neither shows smaller and the one before is held back over the app buttons.

Given an overlay whose frame fades while the window edits another, dark pills over a white backdrop and light ones over a black one, when it is painted, then each value keeps 3:1 against what borders it.

Given the board's fan answering only after a full 30 s load, and readings that stop under the load before the fan answers, when the finder replays each, then the first load runs 30 s, the second ends once the readings have been gone 8.5 s, and both pick the fan by watching after the load.

Given an overlay at size 2 on taskbars of each height and scale, and free, when the window previews it, then the preview is painted as high as the overlay shows, in the monitor's pixels and never higher than the taskbar; and in a narrow column it is painted at the smaller scale that fits it, never wider.
Given two overlays on one taskbar, the second hidden on its own, when the window works out where the first shows, then it is where it shows alone, as a hidden overlay pushes none.

Given three devices, the second of which blocks its update for 5 s from its second read on, when the service reads them each second, then the other two are read every second, the blocked one keeps its last values for up to 3 s and then reads as missing, it is never started again while it runs, and once it returns it is logged as slow once, with how long it took, and read again.

Given a device that stalls and then fails, one that fails once, one that never reads, and a drive read every 5 s whose reads stall and fail, when the service reads them each second, then the first two keep their last values throughout, the drive keeps its values between reads and for 3 s after a failed read came due, then reads as missing, each failure is logged with how it failed at most once a minute, and the one that never read is left out silently.

Given two overlays on a taskbar, when one grows, is dropped or is shown again into the other, and then hides, shrinks or another grows toward it, then the pushed one keeps the place it was pushed to, none goes back toward the taskbar's start, none swaps places, and one undo takes back the edit and the push together; on a nearly full taskbar, a move without room is refused and changes nothing, and one shown again squeezes none.

Given the default overlay, overlays of one pill, without labels and in one bar, and four overlays, when an item's value or a pill's label is held until it lifts and dropped on the desktop or a taskbar's mark, then the value lifts the item alone and the label its pill, without labels the pill, in one bar the run or the item; an item of a one-pill overlay held by its label moves the whole overlay; at four overlays the hold is refused; and each drop is one undo step.

Given an item lifted from the CPU pill, when it is dropped on its own pill before another item or past the last, on its own place, before another pill of its overlay, or on another overlay, then it moves within its pill, stays put, or joins as a pill of its own before the pill it was dropped in front of.

Given the default overlay, and one whose second CPU pill starts apart from the first, when an item is lifted off its pill and dropped before its own pill, moved within it, or dropped on the desktop, then the pill it leaves keeps its label and stays apart, the item shows as a pill of its own, and every other pill shows unchanged.

Given the overlay on a desktop of its own, when an item's value in the CPU pill is held until it lifts and thrown far, the CPU label is held and thrown far, or the CPU temperature's value is dropped on the end of its pill, then the item alone, or the whole CPU pill, becomes an overlay of its own, or the temperature moves to the end of its pill; and a held press on a locked overlay moves and writes nothing.

Given the installed thermi, when an item's value in the CPU pill is held and dragged over its own pill, over another pill and onto the desktop, then the item rises alone as its picture with the CPU label, leaving an empty slot of its size, the bar marks the place between the items over its own pill and before the pill elsewhere, and the pill's label held lifts the whole pill.

Given the CPU temperature's page with its warning and critical lines and a gap in its ten minutes, when the pointer is over the plot in the gap and 40 s ago, and then the chart takes the focus and End, Left, Home and Esc are pressed, then the label shows the bridge's point of that second above Min · Avg · Max; the chart, a slider, gives each key's point to a screen reader as its value and keeps it through the pointer's moves; and Esc hides the label.

Given the window's bridge on the recorded PC, when three snapshots come that Core cannot read, and then a good one, then the page hears nothing of the bad ones, its view keeps the last snapshot's values, the log says it once, and the good one's values show and reach the page.

Given the overlay registering for a restart, when it registers traced and untraced, then Windows keeps `--trace` or no arguments, and the flags that keep it from restarting the overlay after an update of thermi or of Windows.

Given the installed thermi running for over a minute, when its overlay process crashes and then hangs until Windows offers to close it, then Windows offers to restart it and one overlay comes back, with no settings window; when it crashes within its first minute, or is ended from Task Manager or by "Exit thermi", nothing starts it again; and `scripts/install.ps1` run over it leaves one overlay.

Given pills of their own dark, mid and bright colors on dark and light themes, with Auto text, a chosen label too close to the pill, 36 px values, one bar, and high contrast, when the look is read, then the pills, their border, track and a bar's inner pills take that color, the inner ones 1.5:1 to 2:1 from it, Auto text 4.5:1 and each default level 3:1 from it and the track, the chosen label is drawn in its Auto color and flagged, the pill is 1.9 times the text high, high contrast's colors win, and Auto, or a theme chosen in the window or by an agent, gives the theme's pills back.

Given the installed thermi on a 1080p monitor at 100 % and a 4K one at 150 %, when the author sets 400 % with 36 px text and picks a pill color, free, in each corner and on the taskbar, then the overlay paints sharp and whole within the monitor, on the taskbar as high as it, the preview and Copy as image match it, and `scripts/measure.ps1` holds the overlay's budget.

Given the default overlay and a second one, when a pill's row is moved by Alt+Up or Alt+Down, also past either end, and an item's row is dropped before another overlay's item, apart above its pill, on its heading, or on itself, then the pill moves whole, the item lands there, an overlay left empty goes, a move past an end or onto itself changes nothing, and each move is one undo step.

Given the Appearance page, when a number off the slider's steps is typed in Size's box and kept with Enter, one past the end in Background opacity's kept as the focus leaves, text that is no number in the gap's, Esc after typing, and in a text size's box a size off its list and one past its end, then the settings hold the number typed, the nearest end, or what they held, each box shows what the settings hold, and Narrator hears why for the end and for the text.

Given a table of what is typed in a slider's box: a number off its steps with its unit in Spanish's number format, one between whole pixels, one past the low end, one that is not finite, and a text size between halves, when C# reads it, then it keeps the number rounded as its field keeps it, or the nearest end and says so, or keeps nothing and says the value stays.
